title: Automate a control with an automation track
summary: An automation track moves a control over time. Choose its target, pick a record mode (Touch, Latch or Write), and shape the curve.
alternateQueries: How do I change the curve?

steps.instruction: Press the kind button in a track's header and choose Automation.
Press the target button (shown as No Target until chosen) and pick what this lane controls.
Choose the record mode with the mode button.
steps.expectedResult: Touch, Latch or Write is shown.

blocks.definition: Records while you move the control.
Keeps recording after you let go of the control.
Records continuously for the whole pass.

blocks.text: Points on a lane can use a curve shape: Linear, Step, S-Curve, Power or Bezier. Right-click a point and choose Delete Point to remove it. The recording resolution (points per second) is a submenu on the lane.
